description: Blazing fast and simple app logger.
releaseNotes:
3.0.0 Removed file name logging by StackFrame and added parameter for file name to the log methods.
            However, the attribute [CallerfilePath] is not used, because it can leak an info about the machine where the project was built (it is possible to create your own custom logging facade, where the attribute [CallerfilePath] can be used).
            Added possibility to instantiate the logger and thus use constructor parameters to configure the logger, that means, the logging parameters can be specified in the appsettings.json file for instance and passed to the logger instantiated in AddSingleton, or in the own custom logging facade.
      2.0.0 Using [CallerMemberName] and [CallerLineNumber] attributes to get method names and line numbers, because stack frame doesnt handle the async Task methods properly.
			      [CallerfilePath] is not used, because it can leak info about the machine where the project was built.
				    The interface has changed slightly. Params method now requires an explicit "logMessages: [string 0, string 1, string 2...]" array, see readme for more details.
            I might consider to remove file names completly in the future.
      1.7.3 Approximate number of log entries in a log file reduced from 24000 to 16000. 16000 entries in a log file is more then enough.
      1.7.2 Removed the only throw when the directory structure can not be created for the log files for whatever reason. The logger will never crash the parent application now.
      1.7.1 Only netstandard2.1 left as supported library.
      1.7.0 Added global disable of logging in the config. Added local disable per method which does not use params parameter. Added safe string format for log methods with params parameter.
      1.6.0 Removed useless check for free space when creating log files. Improved internal error logging.
      1.5.0 Also zipping the last log file. This might be inconvenient during testing, but at least the logger won't leave unzipped files in production.
      1.4.1 Disposing the AutoResetEvent when exiting the application process.
      1.4.0 Improved disk writing and cancellation of the disk writer task.
      1.3.0 Added support for AssemblyName in LoggerConfig.xml.
      1.2.0 Added a stream flush after writing log entries to the stream writer. This forces the buffer to be written to disk immediately, in case it's not full and is sporadically filled with small chunks of data, which would otherwise delay flushing for a long time.
      1.1.1 Path.GetTempPath() method used for default log path if log path from config is not read properly.
      1.1.0 Removed OS platform checks. Removed OS platform hardcoded default path, the default path is now current working directory of the executable.
      1.0.1 Syntax cosmetics.
			1.0.0 Initial release.
